{{Quote|My wingman's down - stay out of range of Aegis Base, they've got cannon!|Kilit Three|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Kilit Three''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Kilit Squadron]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the squadron participated in the attack on the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Aegis Base]], during which Kilit Three was shot down.
